ශී ලංකා පජාතාන්තික සමාජවාදී ජනරජෙය් ගැසට් පතය
අති විෙශෂ
No. 1977/2 – MONDAY, JULY, 25, 2016
EXTRAORDINARY

THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460) AS AMENDED BY THE LAND ACQUISITION (AMENDMENT) ACT, No. 28 OF 1964 Notice under Section 7 My Ref: ඉ/අත්/UDA/351. I hereby give public notice, under sub-section 1 of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, as amended by the Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964, that the Government intends to acquire the following land for a public purpose. Description of the land to be acquired : The land depicted in the Surveyor General’s Preliminary Plan No. 9634 having an Extent of 0.8207 Hectare, in the Grama Niladari Division No. 498 A of Makumbura North Maharagama Divisional Secretary’s Division, Colombo District in the Western Province. Lot No. 1

Name of the Land: Mahakumbura Welyaya; Description: Abandoned paddy field and Owita, 13 Nos. of Coconut trees within 15 – 20 years old; Ownership: Yasapala Elvitigala and others of Makumbura Pannipitiya; Extent: 0.4180 Hectare.
Lot No. 2
Name of the Land: Mahakumbura Welyaya; Description: Abandoned paddy field; Ownership: Hendrik & others of Makumbura Pannipitiya; Extent: 0.2960 Hectare. Lot No. 3

Name of the Land: Mahakumbura Welyaya; Description: Abandoned paddy field, 5 Nos. of Coconut trees within 15 - 20 years old and well; Ownership: Kaluthanthreege Indrawathie Peiris of No. 185/A, Malapalla Pannipitiya; Extent: 0.0942 Hectare. Lot No. 4

Name of the Land: Not known; Description: Road; Ownership: Not known; Extent: 0.0125 Hectare. All persons interested in the aforesaid land, are hereby required to appear personally or through their agents, duly authorized in writing before me at Divisional Secretariat, Maharagama on the 24th August, 2016 at 9.00 a.m. and all hereby requested to notify to me in writing (in duplicate) on or before 29th July, 2016 the nature of their interests in the land, the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said land, the amount of compensation, and the details of the compensation of such amount.

CORRECTION - NOTE THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460) Notice Under Section 7 My No.: Bagama/DS/2/2/575. THE details of lot No. 18 of Preliminary Plan No. 3283 mentioned in the notice under sub-section (1) of section 7 of the land Acquisition Act, Published by the Divisional Secretary - Baddegama in the Extra ordinary Gazette No. 1301/18 dated 15.08.2003 should be amended as the note appearing below. AMENDMENT All Persons interested in the allotment of the land to appear personally or by the agent duly authorized in writing before me at the divisional secretariat Baddegama on the 14th day of September, 2016 at 10.30 a.m. and are hereby requested to notify to me in writing (in duplicate) on or before the 7th day of September, 2016 the nature of their interest in the land the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said land the amount of compensation and details of the computation of such amount.
